target: More efficient, production PostgreSQL drop-in replacement; MySQL/TDS compatibility also requested

gates.requirement: Complete the PostgreSQL feature inventory, upstream and application regressions, and stock tooling round trips.
gates.qualified: All 106 PostgreSQL smoke programs match frozen PostgreSQL 18.3 using the strict comparator and documented per-scope profiles. PG16 and PG18 each pass 48 stock tooling, 10 large-object and 13 file/routine privilege/WAL checks, including plain/custom archives, global/per-schema defaults, routine ownership/delegation, rule/trigger effects, namespace deletion, concurrent default visibility and rollback/recovery. Reports record their separately compiled binary hashes. The 755-record upstream inventory, separate native dialect lanes and broader application/production qualification remain open. Implicit view/materialized-view return rules render their actual SELECT; stock fixtures execute pretty/non-pretty actions under empty search_path and compare rows and column names/type OIDs before dump and after restore/reopen.

gates.requirement: Synchronous commit-before-ack; crash recovery; exclusive writer; failed-storage guards
Complete role and privilege parity and authenticated MySQL/TDS support.
gates.qualified: PostgreSQL SCRAM, SCRAM-PLUS and catalog role credential configurations.

gates.requirement: Finish exact-artifact TLS qualification across hosted platforms, including documented worker, cluster and listener gaps.
gates.qualified: PostgreSQL TLS 1.3 preview with channel binding, encrypted cancellation and explicit native workers qualified with libpq on Linux.

gates.requirement: Qualify wide schemas, multiple 100M-row tables, mixed read/write concurrency and bounded execution.
gates.qualified: Runtime table and query budgets, native workers, and two 100M-row packed tables with PostgreSQL COPY, joins, aggregates and crash replay under the compact header profile. Wide schemas and mixed-write concurrency remain open.

gates.requirement: Full catalog images, online backup, automatic retirement, bounded write stalls and upgrade migration.
gates.qualified: Offline whole-WAL copy and opt-in live checkpoint generation publication, WAL handoff and process-crash recovery for supported single-database images. RSBASE10 preserves supported public routines, ownership/delegated ACLs, triggers and DO NOTHING rules through live rotation and reopen. Other catalog classes/layouts remain open.

gates.requirement: Qualify published artifacts across the original full suite and production-like workloads, including multi-table reads and durable concurrency.
gates.qualified: The wider published image passed the three capacity probes and both mixed sales workloads. Its eight-client million-row lookup measured 2.04x PostgreSQL in the paired hosted run and 1.84x on the earlier runner, both with opt-in Linux loopback reply caching. The full gate and production workload comparison remain open.

gates.requirement: Service lifecycle, deployment monitoring, general migrations and native SB0 hosted-feature parity.
gates.qualified: Six hosted packages, native SB0X and SB0K boot qualification, PostgreSQL cancellation and documented checkpoint recovery.

gates.requirement: Physical power interruption, directory synchronization faults and storage device fault qualification.
gates.qualified: Process termination around manifest publication and WAL handoff, and an injected selector rename failure.
